overview.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(i.price),2) AS sales_brl, ROUND(SUM(i.price)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) AS average_brl FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id

top_categories.sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(SUM(i.price),2) AS sales_brl FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY sales_brl DESC LIMIT 5

item_grain.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id, order_item_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

order_fk.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orphan_items FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL

jul_aug_change.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-08-01' THEN i.price ELSE -i.price END),2) AS delta_brl FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'

category_contributions.sql: SELECT p.product_category_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-08-01' THEN i.price ELSE -i.price END),2) AS delta_brl FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN products p ON i.product_id=p.product_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01' GROUP BY p.product_category_name ORDER BY delta_brl LIMIT 5
